profile.summary: Public Profit is a consulting firm in Oakland, California that works with mission-driven organizations. It helps them learn from data, make decisions, and improve the quality of their services through evaluation, training, strategic program design, and data visualization. Much of its work has focused on afterschool and out-of-school-time programs.
